metaphor that crystallizes this pattern comes from story about how mastery develops traditional indian yoga the story journalist interviewing indian yoga master asked how became teacher the master replied that before became teacher his own right had studied with twenty different teachers each was narrow specialist one taught particular asana lineage another specific pranayama techniques another the philosophical foundations another therapeutic applications for back pain another work with mental health conditions another the relationship between hatha yoga and physiotherapy another meditation the patanjali tradition another breath work for performers another teaching children another working with the elderly and for twenty distinct teachers the master asked characterize his own teaching said none his twenty teachers taught what teaches each contributed specialization the combination that twenty first teacher was uniquely his had selected from pool hundreds possible teachers across decades choosing the twenty whose combined teachings formed his particular path what this pattern reveals several things about this story warrant attention the teachers are individually general each the twenty teaches their specialty many students any them might chosen different student building different combination the combination individually uncommon while each teacher general the specific selection twenty out hundreds available and the way those twenty combine this particular student understanding rare the selection itself meaningful the master did not randomly accumulate twenty teachers chose them based his developing sense what his path would the selection reflects judgment about what specializations matter what balance for what purpose the combination produces something new what the master teaches not the union what his twenty teachers taught something that emerges from the combination informed all twenty but not equivalent their sum the pattern repeatable but not duplicable other students could similarly study with twenty teachers and develop their own composite mastery but each composite would different the pattern study with many narrow specialists and
